newsitem.title: USA: PPG share profits reached new high in Q2.
newsitem.headline: PPG share profits reached new high in Q2.

text.p: PPG Industries Inc Wednesday said it had record per share earnings in the second quarter on slightly lower net income.
Second-quarter net income was $218 million, or $1.21 per share, on sales of $1.94 billion. Net income a year ago was $229 million, or $1.20 a share, on sales of $1.91 billion.
The average number of shares outstanding in the quarter declined to 180.1 million from 188.6 million a year ago.
"Europe's economies are still sluggish -- although we've seen some encouraging signs of recovery there -- and the North American economy remains healthy," the company said.

"Globally, our focus on high-growth businesses and continuous efficiency improvements in all of our operations are evidence of our long-term commitment to stronger performance and increasing shareholder rewards."

Record second-quarter sales and operating earnings for PPG's coatings segment were driven by strong volume gains, particularly in industrial coatings. Earnings also benefited from modest price improvements, partially offset by costs associated with new initiatives in South America and Asia as well as in the industrial coatings business.

Glass segment sales and operating earnings were off slightly compared with the 1996 quarter, mainly because of lower prices. However, there were significant improvements in European flat glass and fiber glass volumes. In addition, the benefits of global manufacturing efficiencies in the first six months approached those achieved in all of 1996.

PPG's chemicals segment achieved record sales, although operating earnings were slightly lower than those a year ago. Caustic soda prices were weaker than a year ago. However, specialty chemicals performance was strong, again led by volume improvements in the optical products business, which includes Transitions photochromic plastic eyewear lenses.
